scenarios.task: Hand-dig trial pits and shore a trench for a new utility duct near the Broad Street Pump replica plaza.
hazards: buried legacy utilities in old Soho street
struck-by from plant working in tight plaza
steps: Complete permit-to-dig and utility scan review.
Set up barriers and pedestrian walkway around the pit.
Hand-dig trial pits to locate buried services.
Install trench box and ladder access.
Backfill and compact in lifts on completion.
Restore plaza paving and clear the site.

rubric.pass_if: Verifies scans and hand-digs within 500 mm of marked services before striking.
Enters trench only after shoring or box is installed and inspected.
Maintains continuous barriers and safe pedestrian route.
Removes spoil from trench edge and clears walkways.

scenarios.robot_role: Tows spoil bins and carries trench box panels across the plaza so laborers stay clear of plant movement.

scenarios.task: Rig and set the cast-iron Broad Street Pump replica onto its new granite plinth in the Soho plaza.
steps: Confirm exclusion zone with signallers at plaza edges.
Inspect slings, shackles and pump lifting points.
Rig pump with tag line attached.
Direct crane pick with agreed hand signals.
Guide pump over plinth and lower onto setting blocks.
Final position, unrig and clear rigging gear.

rubric.pass_if: Public kept out of landing zone for entire lift.
Rejects any damaged sling or shackle before the lift.
Uses standard hand signals and confirms each with the crane op.
Tag line keeps load controlled and no one under suspended load.

scenarios.task: Install and commission a new branch circuit and data drop for the Progress Observatory public health map kiosk beside the pump replica.
hazards: live services in existing plaza columns
working at height on kiosk header
steps: Isolate and lock out the feed at the local board.
Verify de-energized with proven tester.
Contour cable in plaza ducting to kiosk base.
Terminate at kiosk RCD-protected spur and data outlet.
Test polarity, earth continuity and RCD trip.
Energize, function-test kiosk and label circuit.

rubric.pass_if: Applies lockout-tagout and proves dead before working.
All tests pass and are recorded before energizing.
Cable routing leaves no trip hazards or open duct covers unattended.
Circuit is RCD-protected and correctly labelled.

scenarios.task: Build and level a timber-framed display wall for outcome-tracking exhibits inside the Progress Observatory pavilion.
steps: Set out frame lines from approved drawing.
Cut studs and rails; keep saw bench dust-extracted.
Assemble frame square on the floor.
Raise, plumb and brace frame to slab.
Fix ply sheathing, leaving service cutouts.
Check tolerances and hand over for finishing.

rubric.pass_if: Uses extraction or cutting station and wears respiratory PPE.
Frame square and plumb within tolerance.
Braces frame before it is sheeted.
Keeps hands clear of nailer line and triggers guarded.

scenarios.robot_role: Holds panels in position for fastening, reducing manual handling of heavy sheet goods.

scenarios.task: Bolt up the canopy steel frame over the Proposal Forum seating area, working from mobile elevated work platforms.
hazards: fall from height at connection points
dropped bolts and tools onto plaza
wind loading on partially bolted frame
steps: Confirm MEWP inspection and tie-off anchor points.
Stage members and bolts in canvas tool bags.
Torque first bolts finger-tight at each connection.
Complete bolt-up pattern per drawing sequence.
Torque-check to spec and paint-mark each bolt.
Remove all loose items and secure drop zone.

rubric.pass_if: Ties off 100% of the time at height; no free climbing steel.
All tools tethered or bagged; exclusion zone below maintained.
Follows sequence and torque-marks every bolt.
Halts erection work when wind exceeds site limit.

scenarios.robot_role: Carries bolt buckets and small tools up the work zone perimeter and inspects connection torque marks for QA photo record.

scenarios.task: Fabricate and hang galvanized ductwork for a new fume extract system serving the Research Synthesis Lab sample-prep bench.
hazards: working at height on scaffold tower
awkward manual handling of duct sections
steps: Measure route and mark out duct runs.
Fabricate sections with safe sheet-handling technique.
Assemble tower scaffold and inspect before use.
Hang hangers and lift duct sections in sequence.
Seal joints and label isolation damper.
Balance airflow and record result.

rubric.pass_if: Handles sheet with gloves and deburrs edges before carrying.
Scaffold inspected and brakes set before each use.
All joints sealed and leak-tested before balance.
Records damper positions and airflow readings.

scenarios.task: Repipe the small recirculating water feature in the Charter Hall forecourt that echoes the original pump handle.
hazards: awkward confined working chamber under plinth
hot works risk if brazing near timber decking
steps: Isolate, lock off and depressurize the recirculation loop.
Drain and capture water to prevent slip hazards.
Remove corroded pipework in the plinth chamber.
Fit new PPRA pipework and pressure test.
Dose, flush and sample per water hygiene plan.
Reinstate covers and record maintenance log.

rubric.pass_if: Proves depressurized before breaking joints.
Follows dosing and sampling plan; no chemical spills.
Uses safe access and ventilation in plinth chamber.
Maintenance log and sample result completed.

scenarios.task: Fault-find and replace failed drivers in the plaza accent lighting that illuminates the pump replica at night, working from a small van lift.
hazards: live testing at height in a van basket
steps: Set out night works signage and cone off lift footprint.
Inspect van lift and wear full-body harness to basket.
Isolate circuit and prove dead at first fitting.
Replace failed driver and re-lamp as needed.
Test insulation and function before re-energizing.
Sign off defects and remove temporary traffic management.

rubric.pass_if: Footway protected and lit diversions in place all night.
Proves dead before opening fittings; tests before re-energizing.
Harness clipped and basket not overloaded.
All fittings function and paperwork signed same night.

scenarios.robot_role: Carries spare drivers and test gear from the van to the lift base, reducing apprentice climbs up and down.

credential.name: Broad Street Site Readiness Card (Soho Plaza Works)
